The cost of fragmentation

More networks shouldn’t mean more resources.

Every new retail media network can introduce another setup flow, reporting view, ROAS definition and way of working. The result is a growing operational burden at exactly the point your team needs more pace, clarity and control.

SETUP FRICTION

Repeated Campaign Setup

Rebuilding the same campaign across every retailer / retail media network is a huge drain on time and resources. Every launch means repeating the same work, slowing your team down and creating room for error.

More setup. Less leverage.

KPI MISMATCH

Fragmented Reporting

Different dashboards and definitions make cross-retailer performance harder to compare.

Disconnected metrics. Slower decisions.

INERTIA

Complexity at scale

Multiple reporting spreadsheets take time to build, reconcile and review. The more networks you add, the more resource is tied up in reporting rather than acting.

Growth shouldn’t mean more admin.
